purpose: Repair the v1 protocol's zero-positive support failure without reusing any successful confirmation/disagreement outcomes. Keep the same incremental-over-frozen-v1 target, normalized feature family, model class, retained-incumbent architecture, and conservative fallback logic, but collect a wholly new development batch with exhaustive audit of the exact v1-stop region before fitting.
frozen_prior_result: scaled_dev_v1 failed before fit because all 65 permitted v1-stop development states had target 0. No v1 threshold or feature was retuned on that result.
search_contract: Exactly the frozen challenger-v1 search contract: retained complete natural+RCM two-arm incumbent; independently chosen seeded start; deterministic one-variable remove/reinsert neighborhood; width<=current_width+1 filter; strict best-live stage acceptance; max two accepted moves; Hamming-rank oracle on candidates and endpoint-local direct truth oracle on selected endpoints.

logging_policy.index65: Evaluate seeded initial order plus 64 candidate compilations unless exhausted; no verified benefit certificate may have occurred for a stop-region row.
logging_policy.frozen_v1_stop: best_gap65>11 with active challenger and no certificate by index65.
logging_policy.audit: For every new-development stop-region row, continue the challenger exhaustively with audit propensity exactly 1.0 and record eventual best verified live nodes and tail cost. For non-stop rows, do not use their tail outcome as a stop-region training label.
logging_policy.safety: The verified incumbent is retained throughout; exhaustive audit can consume extra development compute but can never force a worse final endpoint.
logging_policy.future_live_system_note: If the same idea is used in an online costly system, stop-region audits require an explicit nonzero randomized propensity and propensity logging. This offline synthetic development batch uses propensity 1.0 to maximize label support.

target.binary: 1 iff exhaustive post-index65 continuation improves strictly over the endpoint frozen v1 would return at that stop state

features: Exactly the 27 normalized features frozen in coalition_seeded_tail_value_model_scaled_dev_v1_protocol.json; no feature addition/deletion is permitted after these new labels are observed.
model: Exactly StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1,class_weight=balanced,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=2000,random_state=0) on applicable stop-region rows only.

support_gate.failure: If any condition fails, freeze insufficient-support and do not fit or retune this model on the same batch.

development_validation.threshold: Largest unique OOF probability with positive recall>=0.80 and gain-weighted recall>=0.80; if none, fail without retuning.

ood_and_uncertainty: Reuse the v1 protocol's axis-aligned normalized-feature support guard and 200-refit bootstrap vote. Bounds and refits are computed only after this protocol's development rows are collected and only if the support gate passes.
confirmation: No new confirmation seeds may be selected or evaluated until a final v2 model artifact is frozen. Development results are never reused as confirmation.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only. This collection repairs label support for the optional-compute controller; it is not formal-proof confirmation.
